g.text: Tunnel vxlan or geneve, immutable once set
Pod and service subnets fixed once set
Whatever CNI runs stays: never installed,
No Cilium, tunnel, hand-over, cni operations
Switching kube-proxy: ichor set kube-proxy, in the only safe order
Network policy gate: Ichor's CiliumNetworkPolicy objects are applied only when the detected CNI is Cilium
and the CRD exists. Otherwise ichor-system is not isolated by Ichor and NetworkPoliciesApplied says so.
